method.transport: Existing Vercel CLI api with JSON stdin; response captured in memory; no secret arguments or temporary files
method.keychain: Native Swift Security API; exact existing item persistent reference; value-only update through stdin; preserve access control and original JSON/base64 JSON codec

verification: Only the exact old diagnostic key is removed and exactly one new key appears
All other bypass entries and project configuration must be unchanged
Keychain expected-value comparison and readback must succeed
No Google/LINE/Facebook/application credentials, roles, sessions, database or environments are changed
failureBehavior: Stop on any mismatch. If the provider may have rotated but local update did not complete, report reconciliation required; do not blindly retry or recreate the revoked key.
